exact_deck_limit: Fewer than 20 distinct owner cards are exposed; no complete opened deck/discard census or verified empty-deck closure. DECK_USED.json is the separate supplied 20-card snapshot and is not used to inflate seen counts.
repeated_sighting_policy: Counts are simultaneous physical lower bounds, not sums of hand draws or repeated sightings. Evolving preserves the lower card; Tools count separately once. Moving or discarding a seen card adds no copy.
copycat_and_recycling_check: Copycat stays in hand and is never played. One Lucky Ice Pop is seen at T4/T6 starts, then used twice in T6. Heads at F0101.30 returns the same card; its second use reaches Lapras 90 HP at F0106.40, Tails at F0109.30 discards it, and F0110.60 shows it atop the owner discard. Count is one physical card, not two plays.
opened_discard_limit: Neither pile is opened in the reviewed source. Exposed top cards are partial observations only.
energy_limit: Generated Energy is not a physical deck-card slot and is recorded per Pokemon in the supplement.
scope: Full 19-turn source-bound core supplies action coverage. Fresh native reads cover all nine owner starts, evolution anchors, both Research printings, Lucky Ice Pop resolution, T15 replacement and final bench knockout. This is not a redundant full-video pass.
